tests.name: MHPCO claim office quotes an empty item list as 5 G -- only the processing fee
MHPCO claim office quotes a plain sword for a 0-year customer as 115 G -- 100 base + 10 first insurance + 5 fee
MHPCO claim office quotes a plain amulet for a 0-year customer as 71 G -- 60 base + 6 first insurance + 5 fee
MHPCO claim office quotes a plain staff for a 0-year customer as 93 G -- 80 base + 8 first insurance + 5 fee
MHPCO claim office quotes a plain potion for a 0-year customer as 49 G -- 40 base + 4 first insurance + 5 fee
MHPCO claim office quotes a single rune for a 0-year customer as 33 G -- 25 base + 2.5 first insurance + 5 fee, rounded up
MHPCO claim office quotes a single moonstone for a 0-year customer as 33 G -- 25 base + 2.5 first insurance + 5 fee, rounded up
MHPCO claim office base premium for 2 runes is 50 G -- no block
MHPCO claim office base premium for 3 runes is 60 G -- the block applies
MHPCO claim office base premium for 4 runes is 100 G -- no block, a block requires exactly 3
MHPCO claim office base premium for 7 runes is 175 G -- no block within 7 alike components
MHPCO claim office base premium for 2 runes + 1 moonstone is 75 G -- no block, types differ
MHPCO claim office base premium for 3 runes + 3 moonstones is 120 G -- two separate blocks
MHPCO claim office a cursed sword adds a 50 % curse surcharge to that item's base premium -- 50 G on 100 G
MHPCO claim office a sword with enchantment 5 adds a 30 % high-enchantment surcharge -- 30 G on 100 G
MHPCO claim office a sword with enchantment 4 adds no high-enchantment surcharge
MHPCO claim office a cursed sword with enchantment 5 adds both surcharges -- 50 G + 30 G on 100 G
MHPCO claim office on a policy with a cursed sword and a plain amulet the curse surcharge is 50 G -- 50 % of the cursed item only, not of the 160 G policy total
MHPCO claim office a customer with exactly 2 years with MHPCO receives the 20 % loyalty discount
MHPCO claim office a customer with 1 year with MHPCO receives no loyalty discount
MHPCO claim office the 10 % first-insurance surcharge applies on the policy base premium of every quote
MHPCO claim office the second quote in a scenario receives the 15 % follow-up contract discount
MHPCO claim office the first quote in a scenario receives no follow-up contract discount
MHPCO claim office policy-wide modifiers apply to the sum of item base premiums, the 5 G fee is added last
MHPCO claim office a premium of 197.5 G is rounded up to 198 G -- rounding favours MHPCO
MHPCO claim office intermediate premium amounts stay fractional, only the final premium is rounded
MHPCO claim office newcomer with a cursed steel sword of enchantment 3 pays 165 G -- 100 + 50 curse + 10 first insurance + 5 fee
MHPCO claim office 3-year customer's second quote for a cursed steel sword of enchantment 7 pays 160 G -- 100 + 50 + 30 - 20 + 10 - 15 + 5
MHPCO claim office a policy of one sword has insurance sum 1000 G and cap 2000 G
MHPCO claim office a policy of a sword and an amulet has insurance sum 1600 G and cap 3200 G
MHPCO claim office a policy of a sword and 3 runes has insurance sum 1750 G -- the block discount does not lower the insurance sum
MHPCO claim office a policy of two swords has insurance sum 2000 G and cap 4000 G
MHPCO claim office a cursed sword's cap stays 2000 G -- premium modifiers do not raise the cap
MHPCO claim office a steel sword of enchantment 3 damaged by 500 G pays out 400 G -- full reimbursement minus the 100 G deductible
MHPCO claim office a rune damaged by 200 G pays out 100 G -- runes have no enchantment or material, so no special clause applies
MHPCO claim office the 100 G deductible applies once per damaged item -- 500 G sword + 300 G amulet pays out 600 G
MHPCO claim office a steel sword of enchantment 9 damaged by 1000 G pays out 400 G -- 50 % high-enchantment clause, then deductible
MHPCO claim office a sword of exactly enchantment 8 is reimbursed at 50 % -- the threshold is inclusive
MHPCO claim office a dragon-material sword of enchantment 5 damaged by 800 G pays out 700 G -- full reimbursement, then deductible
MHPCO claim office a dragon-material sword of enchantment 9 damaged by 1000 G pays out 400 G -- the 50 % rule wins over full reimbursement
MHPCO claim office a dragon-material sword of exactly enchantment 8 damaged by 1000 G pays out 400 G
MHPCO claim office a first 1500 G claim on a 1000 G sword policy pays out 1400 G and leaves 600 G of cap
MHPCO claim office a second 1500 G claim on the same policy pays out only the remaining 600 G and leaves 0 G of cap
MHPCO claim office a claim beyond an exhausted cap pays out 0 G and leaves 0 G of cap
MHPCO claim office two sword damage entries against a two-sword policy are two separate damages, each with its own deductible
MHPCO claim office a payout of 350.5 G is rounded down to 350 G -- rounding favours MHPCO
MHPCO claim office a damage of 50 G below the 100 G deductible pays out 0 G, not a negative amount
MHPCO claim office the CLI reads a scenario from stdin and writes one result per step to stdout in order
MHPCO claim office the CLI writes a quote step result as {premium} and a claim step result as {payout, remainingCap}
MHPCO claim office the CLI resolves a claim's policy field as the zero-based index of the quote step that created the policy
MHPCO claim office the CLI exits with status 0 on a valid scenario
MHPCO claim office a quote with an unknown item type such as broomstick exits non-zero, writes an error to stderr, and writes no results to stdout
MHPCO claim office a claim whose damaged item is not part of the policy exits non-zero and writes an error to stderr
MHPCO claim office a claim damaging an item of an unknown type exits non-zero and writes an error to stderr
MHPCO claim office a claim with more damage entries of a type than the policy covers exits non-zero and rejects the whole claim
MHPCO claim office a claim with a negative damage amount of -200 exits non-zero and writes an error to stderr
